skill.name: wecomcli-contact
skill.description: 使用 wecom-cli 按姓名、拼音、英文名或别名搜索企业微信通讯录中的人员，并查询匹配人员的 userid、部门和职务。适用于查找联系人、区分同名人员、获取用户 userid，以及列出全部同名人员。
skill.summary: Find WeCom directory contacts by name, pinyin, English name, or alias, and distinguish matches using identifiers and departments.
skill.author: wecomteam

security_audit.summary: All 20 static findings are false positives: Markdown backticks were misidentified as execution, and readable Chinese documentation triggered the entropy heuristic. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential theft, or unauthorized data transfer in SKILL.md. The external CLI and required shared skill were not included, so their behavior remains outside this review.

static_findings.snippet: > 执行任何 `wecom-cli` 命令前,必须先读取并完成 `wecomcli-shared` 技能的公共前置检查。
使用 `wecom-cli` 按关键词搜索企业微信通讯录中的人员。
按关键词批量模糊搜索人员,一次最多 10 个关键词,返回命中 `users` 数组(姓名 / 英文名 / 职务 / 部门)。关键词可匹配的字段包括:姓名(用户名)、姓名拼音、英文名、别名,而不仅限于中
| `keywords` | string[] | 是 | — | 搜索关键词列表,可按姓名(用户名)/ 拼音 / 英文名 / 别名匹配,最多 10 个;多个关键词之间是 OR 关系 |
| `search_mode` | string | 否 | — | 搜索模式,默认不传该参数;仅当需要拿到完整人员名单时,才显式传 `"list"` |
- 默认(不传 `search_mode`):返回最相关的候选结果,用于常规按名 / 拼音等查单个人的场景,绝大多数场景走此分支。
- 传 `search_mode = "list"`:返回全量命中列表。仅当用户明确要"完整名单"时才传,典型话术如"一共有几个张三 / 所有叫李四的人 / 列出全部同名 / 全部同名人员"等清点、穷
| `users[].alias` | string | 英文名 / 别名(可能为空) |
| `users[].position` | string | 管理职务(如"负责人"),**不是**"职位"(可能为空) |
| `users[].matched_keywords` | string[] | 本条 user 命中的请求关键词|
| `users[].departments` | string[] | 所在部门路径列表(从大到小),主部门靠前 |
| `hint` | string | 结果限制提示(可能为空):当某个关键词的命中结果因限制未完整返回时,接口会在此字段给出说明 |

content.user_title: Find WeCom Contacts and User IDs
content.value_statement: Similar names and incomplete contact details can make employee lookup difficult. This skill guides WeCom directory searches and presents identifiers, departments, and matching details.
actual_capabilities: Guide contact searches by name, pinyin, English name, or alias through wecom-cli.
Search up to 10 keywords per request, using OR matching.
Present returned user IDs, names, aliases, emails, management roles, and department paths.
Use list mode when users explicitly request all matching contacts.
Preserve API result order and initially show up to five candidates per keyword in ordinary searches.
Report result-limit hints and request missing search keywords instead of guessing.
limitations: Requires the external wecom-cli binary and the separate wecomcli-shared prerequisite checks.
Accepts at most 10 search keywords per request.
Results can be incomplete because of API limits, including when list mode is requested.
Alias, email, and management-role fields may be empty; the position field is not a general job title.

use_cases.title: Identify a colleague
use_cases.description: Search by English name or pinyin and compare department paths before choosing the intended person.

use_cases.title: Retrieve a user identifier
use_cases.description: Find a contact and report the returned userid after resolving ambiguous matches.

use_cases.title: Review matching names
use_cases.description: Request all contacts matching a name and retain any warning that the returned list is incomplete.

prompt_templates.title: Find one contact
prompt_templates.prompt: Find contacts matching [name] in the WeCom directory.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve similar names
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for [pinyin or English name]. Show user IDs and department paths so I can select the correct person.

prompt_templates.title: Search several keywords
prompt_templates.prompt: Search the WeCom directory for [keyword one], [keyword two], and [keyword three]. Preserve result order and show matched keywords.
prompt_templates.scenario: Batch lookup with up to 10 keywords

prompt_templates.title: Request all matching contacts
prompt_templates.prompt: List all contacts matching [name] using list mode. Include returned user IDs, department paths, and management roles, and report any result-limit hint.

best_practices: Complete the wecomcli-shared prerequisite checks before running any wecom-cli command.
Resolve ambiguous identities using returned identifiers and department paths while preserving API result order.
Use list mode only for explicit complete-list requests, and always report nonempty result-limit hints.
anti_patterns: Guessing search keywords when neither the request nor context supplies them.
Treating the first match as the intended person without resolving ambiguity.
Claiming a list is complete despite a result-limit hint, or presenting a management role as a general job title.

faq.question: What must be available before searching?
faq.answer: The wecom-cli binary must be available. Complete the prerequisite checks defined by the separate wecomcli-shared skill before running commands.

faq.question: Which contact fields can I search?
faq.answer: Keywords can match names, name pinyin, English names, and aliases.

faq.question: Can I search several names at once?
faq.answer: Yes. Each request accepts up to 10 keywords, and contacts matching any keyword can be returned.

faq.question: How are ambiguous matches presented?
faq.answer: Ordinary searches initially show at most five candidates per keyword in API order. More candidates appear only when explicitly requested.

faq.question: Does list mode guarantee every matching contact?
faq.answer: No. List mode requests all matches, but API limits can still restrict results. Any nonempty hint must be disclosed.

faq.question: Can this skill update contacts or send messages?
faq.answer: No. This skill documents contact search only; it does not document contact editing or messaging commands.
